---
name: Scientific correction
about: Something in the UI or docs is biologically wrong, imprecise, or misleading.
title: "[science] "
labels: ["science", "needs-review"]
---

## What we got wrong

Quote the exact line, file, and (if it's in the rendered page) the chapter number.

## The correction

What the line should say instead.

## Source

A primary-source citation (PubMed link, PDB entry, ClinVar record, peer-reviewed paper, etc.). Wikipedia is welcome as orientation but not as the sole source.

## Severity

- [ ] Clinical-adjacent — risks misleading a reader about heat illness
- [ ] Factual — wrong number, wrong protein, wrong relationship
- [ ] Imprecise — true but lossy; a footnote would fix it
- [ ] Cosmetic — typo, naming convention, formatting

## Anything else

Context, related claims that should be checked, or links to deeper background.
